title: 第11章 堆肥沤肥第12章 谢太公
content_zh:
祁澜骑马走在前头，听着后面传来的讨论，没有出声。
有天境之资是一回事，但突破天境也不是那么简单的。
至少目前，他是看不到路的。
光他们长溪部，所修习的玄水真功，最高也就只到地境后期，对于后续如何继续强化气血，突破天境，那是真的一无所知。
整个巴蜀大地，也就蜀侯、巴侯、苴侯三个侯国有着天境武将的传承，其他伯国、子国，也就和他们长溪部相当。
另外，回去之后，赤脉草的事不能对外透露太多细节，顶多也就和长溪子爵说一说好了。
不然传出去杨家能搞到这种级别的灵药，反而又会给人家招来麻烦。
……
……
长溪邑的城墙出现在视野中的时候，祁澜远远就看到了城门口，在雨中站着一群披着蓑衣，戴着斗笠的人。
为首那人，身形魁梧，即便隔着雨水，也透着一股渊渟岳峙的气度。
祁云，长溪子爵。
蓑衣下，是一身玄色锦衣，腰间佩着佩剑，身后跟着几十号人，有家臣，有武士，还有几个宗室长辈和担任官职的大夫。
这阵仗——
祁澜愣了一下，随后
不再迟疑，双腿一夹马腹，脱离队伍，策马向前。
“吁——”
他在城门下勒住马，翻身而下，大步流星地走到祁云面前。
“何劳父亲与诸贤来迎我？”
“打住，别扯那文绉绉的，你就当内史官不在就好。”

祁云抬手止住他的话头，上下打量了自家长子两眼。
那种打量很细，像是在确认什么。片刻后，祁云伸出蒲扇般的大手，拍了拍祁澜的肩膀，力道沉重。
换作半个月前，这一拍能让他身体微晃，而此刻祁澜的身子却如在地上扎了根似的，纹丝不动。
祁云的手从肩上收回来，点了点头。
气血凝实如汞，周天运转不息，的确是入了地境。
“好。”
就这一个字，但祁澜听得出来，老爹压着嗓子，语气有些发紧，压着一股子激动。
高兴的。
祁澜这个继承人成就地境，就已经代表着将来有能力守住这个邦国。
“走，入邑，为父有两件事要告知你。”
祁云转身往城里走，祁澜跟上，其他人自觉地跟在后面，保让出一段距离。
“哪两件？”
“第一件。”祁云脚步不停，声音压低了些，语气中的兴奋还未消散，“你去年让人在城南开辟的那块试验田，结果出来了。”
祁澜脚步一滞。
“堆肥、沤肥之法？”
content_en:
Qi Lan rode ahead and listened to the discussion coming from behind without making a sound.
It is one thing to have the talent of Heaven Realm, but breaking through to Heaven Realm is not that simple.
At least for now, he couldn't see the way.
The Xuanshui True Technique practiced by the Changxi Tribe alone can only reach the late stage of the Earth Realm. They really have no idea how to continue to strengthen Qi and blood and break through to the Heaven Realm in the future.
In the entire land of Bashu, the three princely states of Shu, Bahou, and Juhou have the inheritance of heavenly warriors. The other uncles and sub-states are comparable to their Changxi tribe.
In addition, after returning, we cannot reveal too many details about the Red Vein Grass to the outside world. At most, we can only discuss it with Viscount Changxi.
Otherwise, if word spreads that the Yang family can obtain this level of elixir, it will cause trouble for others.
…
…
When the city wall of Changxi City came into view, Qi Lan saw the city gate from a distance. There was a group of people wearing raincoats and bamboo hats standing in the rain.
The man at the head was tall and tall, and even through the rain, he exuded an air of fortitude.
Qi Yun, Viscount Changxi.
Under the raincoat, he was dressed in black brocade clothes, with a sword on his waist, followed by dozens of people, including retainers, warriors, several clan elders and officials.
This battle——
Qi Lan was stunned for a moment, then
Without any further hesitation, he clamped his legs between the horse's belly, broke away from the team, and spurred the horse forward.
"Uu——"
He reined in his horse under the city gate, turned over, and strode up to Qi Yun.
"Why bother my father and the wise men to come and greet me?"
"Stop it, don't be so docile, just pretend that the internal historian is not here."
Qi Yun raised his hand to stop what he was saying and looked at his eldest son up and down.
That kind of careful observation, like confirming something. After a moment, Qi Yun stretched out his big hand like a cattail leaf fan and patted Qi Lan's shoulder with a heavy force.
Half a month ago, this beat would have made his body sway slightly, but at this moment, Qi Lan's body seemed to be rooted to the ground, motionless.
Qi Yun took his hand back from his shoulder and nodded.
The qi and blood are as solid as mercury, and the heavens are circulating continuously, and they have indeed entered the realm of the earth.
"Okay."
It was just this one word, but Qi Lan could tell that the father was croaking, his tone was a little tight, and he was suppressing a surge of excitement.
Happy.
The success of Qi Lan, the heir, already represents the ability to defend this country in the future.
"Let's go into the city. My father has two things to tell you."
Qi Yun turned around and walked towards the city, Qi Lan followed, and the others consciously followed behind to keep some distance.
"Which two?"
"The first thing." Qi Yun kept walking, his voice lowered, and the excitement in his tone had not dissipated. "The results of the experimental field you opened in the south of the city last year are out."
Qi Lan's steps faltered.
“Methods of composting and retting?”
